target: Expanded Scale infrastructure catalogue and diagnostics

contract.purpose: Turn software engineering study into retained causal understanding backed by evidence.
contract.canonicalPurpose: Personal SWE learning OS with an evidence-gated learning loop.
contract.job: Browse all infrastructure options, compare costs and prerequisites, and diagnose realistic capacity or delivery bottlenecks.
contract.thesis: Keep discovery compact and expose detail only in the chosen activity.
contract.system: Inherit SWE Geist typography, black canvas, neutral surfaces, restrained sky accents, near-white primary controls; emerald health, amber pressure, rose errors.
contract.signature: Different projects expose different bottlenecks in the same measured architecture.
contract.risk: More components must remain navigable without making the workbench or catalogue sprawl.

projectCheck.command: pnpm typecheck; pnpm exec vitest run src/features/scale src/pages/Scale.test.tsx; pnpm build; pnpm exec size-limit; pnpm docs:validate; git diff --check

findings: Self-reviewed preserve-lane catalogue and architecture at 390, 768 and 1440 pixels. No horizontal document overflow. Native disclosure groups retain compact discovery; mobile action rows stack after polish. Dense architectures use a bounded vertical scroll region. No independent reviewer or automated aesthetic detector was used.

ownerFeedback.note: Owner explicitly requires the existing SWE theme and no separate Scale visual identity.
